body.statement: ZengBalakrishnanHanKennedy2024, Theorem 2, establishes on its unit-scale binary one-arm model the minimax squared-error lower bound \(\gtrsim_{\epsilon}\{n^{-1}+d^2/[n^2\log^2(en)]\}\) for estimating \(\psi_1(P)\) in the dimension range used in Appendix C.5.
